title: Phase 2A nomue verification report (with optional attestations)
description: Supersedes urn:nomue:schema:verification-report:0.2.0-draft.1 by adding an OPTIONAL attestations member (NRS-ATTEST-0002, first increment, DRAFT; merged to main - stale merge note corrected 2026-08-13, passive batch alpha, R-11). The draft.1 schema is retained unmodified as a historical artifact; adding attestations here is additive and does not change the meaning of conformance or verification_results. A separate artifact from the Record (NRS-CORE-0008), with no overall status, no VERIFIED value, no significance boolean, and no whole-record validity boolean; every result is inseparable from its check identifier, version, and scope. The guarantee boundary makes the non-claims explicit: scientific validity, declaration truth, distributional-model validity, causal interpretation, and standardized effect size are all not_asserted. attestations, when present, MUST NOT change the meaning of conformance or verification_results (NRS-VERIFY-0004, non-escalation) - this is a structural fact of this schema (attestations is not referenced by conformance or verification_results and adds no path that could mutate them), not something re-derived per report. The 0.2.0-draft.2 schema is retained unmodified; draft.3 adds only the OPTIONAL rfc3161_timestamp assertion member (NRS-ATTEST-0011, EXPERIMENTAL) and aligns the reserved revocation placeholder comment with the ratified v0 no-revocation rule (NRS-ATTEST-0009).

generated_at.$comment: Excluded from the verification semantic projection.

attestations.$comment: OPTIONAL (NRS-ATTEST-0002). Absent on every report produced by the current verifier pipeline, which does not yet attach attestations; present only where a downstream tool has attached one per attach-attestations.ts. Never read by conformance or verification_results.

content_digest.$comment: The independently recomputed digest of the verified revision (NRS-VERIFY-0011).

signatureAlgorithm.$comment: Allow-listed only; no algorithm agility (NRS-ATTEST-0003). PROPOSED, not adopted - see registries/attestation-signature-suites.yaml and gate R1-11.

key_id.$comment: Placeholder identifier only; key custody, distribution, and issuer-identity verification are explicitly open discussion items, not decided by this schema.

outcome.$comment: The already-computed outcome of the named public check on the subject; the assertion attests to this, it does not recompute it.

revocation_reference.$comment: Placeholder field only: no revocation distribution mechanism is defined yet (open discussion item).

revocation.$comment: Reserved placeholder object, INERT by ratified decision: v0 has no revocation mechanism and this member never affects verification outcomes (NRS-ATTEST-0009).

subject.$comment: The specific Record revision this assertion is about (NRS-ATTEST-0002: attester/subject/scope/statement/signature).

scope.$comment: Reuses the same scope shape as a public check result; an attestation is scoped exactly like a verification result is.

statement.$comment: The fixed statement text bound to this identifier is normative in spec/attestation/README.md (NRS-ATTEST-0001) and is not restated here.

signature_verification.$comment: The signature-verification result itself (depth-3 evidence, NRS-ATTEST-0004): a private, attester-key-dependent check whose result lives here, never in the report's own verification_results (NRS-ATTEST-0005).

token.$comment: Base64-encoded RFC 3161 TimeStampToken over the assertion's signing payload.

tsa_name.$comment: Informative TSA identification; an identifier, never dereferenced (NRS-CORE-0004).

rfc3161_timestamp.$comment: OPTIONAL (NRS-ATTEST-0011, EXPERIMENTAL): never a v0 validity or conformance condition; absence carries no claim.
